description: Supporting information and raw data for biomass calculations of canopy spiders The file contains, in columns: Plot, Land Use, Average Body Length, average body width, individual body mass, abundance per plot, abundance per square meter, and total biomass per square meter.Abundances are based on subplots 1+2 per plot, excluding subplot 3.
